callsUsed.brief: Matthew and Dallin from Entrata discussed Landmark's property portfolio, compliance processes, and current system pain points with Corey, a representative from Landmark. They highlighted Entrata's upcoming support for rural development, its integrated website and certification approval routing features, and its ability to streamline affordable housing management. callsUsed.title: Call with Landmark Management, Inc. - Nancy Longwith
callsUsed.brief: Dallin from Entrata spoke with Cori from Landmark Management, who expressed hesitation about transitioning 71 affordable properties to a new system due to the critical nature of their RD (Rural Development) operations. They agreed to revisit a full demo next year after Entrata has addressed initial implementation issues, with Dallin committing to maintaining contact and sharing updates while offering incentives to keep Entrata top-of-mind. Cori acknowledged the value of a backup option and agreed to keep Entrata in consideration.
